evidence_quotes.agenda: Never asked — call stayed limited to pod-unload inventory and pricing

evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: None of the five lines present — no rate-commitment, window framing, beats-it-pay-less, self-prep tip, or fairness check anywhere in the call

top_strength: Caught and transparently corrected her own math error on the estimated budget mid-call rather than leaving the customer with a wrong number.
coaching_note: Save Your Ass was entirely skipped on this call — even a short pod-unload job should get at least the fifteen-minute-increment and window-framing lines before the price is stated.
